name: Yan (An Lushan)
alt: Yan of An Lushan and Shi Siming

predecessors.name: Tang dynasty
predecessors.text: the Fanyang, Pinglu and Hedong garrisons, 'the area north of the lower Yellow River', that An Lushan held as Tang military governor

successors.name: Tang dynasty
successors.text: Hebei, where the surrendered Yan generals (Li Huaixian, Tian Chengsi, Li Baochen and others) were allowed to stay as military governors; the Lulong, Chengde and Weibo circuits

successors.name: Lulong Circuit
successors.text: Youzhou, the former Yan core round modern Beijing, left to the Yan general Li Huaixian

successors.name: Weibo Circuit
successors.text: Weizhou (Daming), where Tian Chengsi 'took control of Weibo in 763'

successors.name: Zhao (Five Dynasties period)
successors.text: the Chengde circuit round Zhen Prefecture, left to the Yan general Li Baozhen

ledger.x: 755: Hebei goes over to An Lushan.
755: war between the rebels and the Tang opens.
756: An Lushan proclaims the Great Yan at Luoyang.
757: Shi Siming and the northern prefectures go over to Tang.
759: Shi Siming takes Kaifeng and Luoyang.
759: Shi Siming takes the Yan throne.

759: Shi Siming takes over An Qingxu's Ye and 'returned to Fanyang', the northern Hebei circuit that had been under Tang since his submission; Wei Prefecture (Handan) was also taken from the Tang general Cui Guangyuan, with the year given as 759-760.
762: Luoyang falls for the last time.
763: the Yan ends and its generals keep their posts.

wars.name: An Lushan rebellion
wars.outcome: Tang victory in February 763 with Uyghur help; the Yan generals who surrendered kept Hebei as semi-independent jiedushi (Lulong, Chengde, Weibo).

wars.name: Siege and battle of Yecheng
wars.outcome: On 7 April 759 'Shi's forces defeated the Tang armies besieging Yecheng when a storm panicked both sides'; the Tang withdrew south, then Shi executed An Qingxu.

certainty.note: A rebel zone with no frontier drawn on any page: Tang pockets (Yan Zhenqing, Taiyuan, Suiyang) stayed inside the area and the front moved with each campaign.
